title: Normalized common residue and principal section kernels for embedded coefficients
statement: Fix the data of [def-sfb-embedded-integral-model-coefficients]: prime ell, finite intermediate E, a generator pi of the maximal ideal, and a Noetherian X. On the coefficient-sized small site let phi be the actual embedded scalar map, q its constant first residue map, and qB the completed first residue map. There exist an isomorphism e from the target of q to the target of qB and a global section r of the source of phi such that q is locally surjective, phi composed with qB equals q composed with e, and on every site object U the section kernels of q and qB are respectively the principal ideals generated by r(U) and phi(r(U)). No module finite-type, flatness, ideal extension, or quotient-isomorphism assertion is included.

proof.text: Apply the scalar-normalized embedded completion diagram. Pull the constant section ULift(pi) back through its source isomorphism to obtain r. Specialize flat_and_quotients to the principal ideal I at exponent one, using a proved private principal-ideal image lemma to replace all ideal elements by its single generator. Transfer surjectivity and both principal kernels through the evaluated ring isomorphisms. Compose the two finite-residue identifications to obtain e. The completion lift/projection equation and the three comparison squares give the required commuting square. The scalar square identifies the completed generator with phi(r).

theorem integralModelsEmbeddedResidueSections
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] :
    let φ := IntegralModelsStacks.smallMap X (IntegralModelsEmbedded.scalarMap ℓ E X)
    let q := IntegralModelsStacks.smallMap X (IntegralModelsEmbedded.residueMap ℓ E π X)
    let qB := IntegralModelsStacks.smallMap X
      (completedCoefficientMap X (completedReduction ℓ E π 0)).hom
    ∃ (e : (Arrow.mk q).right ≅ (Arrow.mk qB).right)
      (r : ((Arrow.mk φ).left.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat.{u + 1}).sections),
      Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} X) q.hom ∧
      φ ≫ qB = q ≫ e.hom ∧
      (∀ U : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} X,
        RingHom.ker (q.hom.app (op U)).hom = Ideal.span {r.val (op U)}) ∧
      (∀ U : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} X,
        RingHom.ker (qB.hom.app (op U)).hom =
          Ideal.span {φ.hom.app (op U) (r.val (op U))})
